with dedup as (

    select
        *,
        row_number() over (
            partition by transaction_id
            order by date_of_sale, address, price_eur
        ) as _dupe_rank
    from "ppr"."main_staging"."stg_ppr__transactions"

),

flagged_dupes as (

    select
        *,
        (_dupe_rank > 1) as is_exact_duplicate
    from dedup

),

mapped as (

    select
        f.*,
        pt.property_type
    from flagged_dupes f
    left join "ppr"."main_seeds"."property_type_map" pt
        on f.description_of_property = pt.description_raw

),

price_bounds as (

    select
        quantile_cont(price_eur, 0.01) as p_low,
        quantile_cont(price_eur, 0.99) as p_high
    from mapped
    where not is_exact_duplicate

),

priced as (

    select
        m.*,
        b.p_low,
        b.p_high,
        least(greatest(m.price_eur, b.p_low), b.p_high) as price_eur_winsorised,
        case
            when m.vat_exclusive and m.property_type = 'NEW'
                then m.price_eur * (1 + 0.135)
            else m.price_eur
        end as price_eur_vat_adjusted
    from mapped m
    cross join price_bounds b

),

with_vat_adjusted_winsor as (

    select
        p.*,
        case
            when p.vat_exclusive and p.property_type = 'NEW'
                then least(greatest(p.price_eur_vat_adjusted, b.p_low * (1 + 0.135)), b.p_high * (1 + 0.135))
            else p.price_eur_winsorised
        end as price_eur_index_basis
    from priced p
    cross join price_bounds b

),

final as (

    select
        transaction_id,
        date_of_sale,
        date_trunc('month', date_of_sale)::date as sale_month,
        address,
        county,
        eircode,
        price_eur,
        price_eur_vat_adjusted,
        price_eur_index_basis,
        not_full_market_price,
        vat_exclusive,
        description_of_property,
        property_type,
        property_size_description,
        is_exact_duplicate,
        case
            when is_exact_duplicate then 'exact_duplicate'
            when not_full_market_price then 'not_full_market_price'
            when property_type is null then 'unmapped_property_type'
            when date_of_sale is null then 'missing_sale_date'
            when price_eur is null or price_eur <= 0 then 'invalid_price'
            else null
        end as exclusion_reason
    from with_vat_adjusted_winsor

)

with cleaned as (

dublin_district_extracted as (

    select
        c.*,
        upper(nullif(trim(substr(c.eircode, 1, 3)), '')) as eircode_routing_key,
        upper(
            regexp_extract(
                upper(c.address), 'DUBLIN[ ]*([0-9]{1,2}W?)\b', 1
            )
        ) as address_district_raw,
        case
            when length(
                upper(regexp_extract(upper(c.address), 'DUBLIN[ ]*([0-9]{1,2}W?)\b', 1))
            ) = 1
            then '0' || upper(regexp_extract(upper(c.address), 'DUBLIN[ ]*([0-9]{1,2}W?)\b', 1))
            else upper(regexp_extract(upper(c.address), 'DUBLIN[ ]*([0-9]{1,2}W?)\b', 1))
        end as address_district_padded
    from cleaned c

),

dublin_district_resolved as (

    select
        d.*,
        coalesce(
            case when d.eircode_routing_key like 'D__' then substr(d.eircode_routing_key, 2, 2) end,
            nullif(d.address_district_padded, '')
        ) as district_code_candidate
    from dublin_district_extracted d

),

national_scope as (

    select
        r.transaction_id,
        r.date_of_sale,
        r.sale_month,
        r.county,
        r.property_type,
        r.price_eur_index_basis,
        'NATIONAL' as region_scope,

        r.property_type || '_' || cr.region as stratum_key
    from dublin_district_resolved r
    left join "ppr"."main_seeds"."county_region_map" cr
        on r.county = cr.county

),

dublin_scope as (

    select
        r.transaction_id,
        r.date_of_sale,
        r.sale_month,
        r.county,
        r.property_type,
        r.price_eur_index_basis,
        'DUBLIN' as region_scope,
        coalesce(dm.district_group, 'DUBLIN_UNKNOWN') as geo_bucket,
        r.property_type || '_' || coalesce(dm.district_group, 'DUBLIN_UNKNOWN') as stratum_key
    from dublin_district_resolved r
    left join "ppr"."main_seeds"."dublin_district_map" dm
        on r.district_code_candidate = dm.district_code
    where r.county = 'DUBLIN'

),

with_yoy as (

        lag(m.n_transactions, 12) over (partition by m.county order by m.sale_month) as n_transactions_yoy_ago,
        lag(m.median_price, 12) over (partition by m.county order by m.sale_month) as median_price_yoy_ago
    from monthly m

select
    md5(cast(coalesce(cast(sale_month as TEXT), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') || '-' || coalesce(cast(county as TEXT), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') as TEXT)) as transaction_volume_id,
    sale_month,
    county,
    n_transactions,
    round(median_price, 2) as median_price,
    case
        when n_transactions_yoy_ago is not null and n_transactions_yoy_ago > 0
        then round(100.0 * (n_transactions - n_transactions_yoy_ago) / n_transactions_yoy_ago, 2)
    end as n_transactions_yoy_pct,
    case
        when median_price_yoy_ago is not null and median_price_yoy_ago > 0

with stratified as (

base_period as (

    select
        region_scope,
        avg(price_eur_index_basis) as base_mean,
        median(price_eur_index_basis) as base_median
    from stratified
    where date_of_sale between
        '2010-01-01'::date and '2012-12-31'::date
    group by 1

),

period_agg as (

    select
        region_scope,
        sale_month,
        avg(price_eur_index_basis) as mean_price,
        median(price_eur_index_basis) as median_price,
        count(*) as n
    from stratified

),

mean_series as (

    select
        p.region_scope,
        p.sale_month,
        'headline_mean' as index_variant,
        100.0 * p.mean_price / b.base_mean as index_value,
        cast(null as double) as effective_weight_sum,
        p.n as n_transactions_used,
        cast(null as integer) as n_strata_used
    from period_agg p
    join base_period b using (region_scope)

),

median_series as (

    select
        p.region_scope,
        p.sale_month,
        'headline_median' as index_variant,
        100.0 * p.median_price / b.base_median as index_value,
        cast(null as double) as effective_weight_sum,
        p.n as n_transactions_used,
        cast(null as integer) as n_strata_used
    from period_agg p
    join base_period b using (region_scope)

)

-- Fails if any (region_scope, weight_variant) combination's fixed weights
-- don't sum to 1.0 within 1e-6.
select
    region_scope,
    weight_variant,
    sum(weight) as weight_sum
from "ppr"."main_intermediate"."int_strata__base_weights"
group by 1, 2
having abs(sum(weight) - 1.0) > 1e-6

with joined as (

    select
        bw.region_scope,
        bw.weight_variant as index_variant,
        pm.sale_month,
        bw.stratum_key,
        bw.weight,
        bw.base_median_price,
        pm.median_price,
        pm.n
    from "ppr"."main_intermediate"."int_strata__base_weights" bw
    join "ppr"."main_intermediate"."int_strata__period_medians" pm
        on bw.region_scope = pm.region_scope
        and bw.stratum_key = pm.stratum_key
    where bw.base_median_price is not null
      and pm.median_price is not null

),

agg as (

    select
        region_scope,
        index_variant,
        sale_month,
        sum(weight) as effective_weight_sum,
        sum(weight * median_price / base_median_price) as weighted_ratio_sum,
        sum(n) as n_transactions_used,
        count(*) as n_strata_used
    from joined
    group by 1, 2, 3

)

select
    region_scope,
    index_variant,
    sale_month,
    100.0 * weighted_ratio_sum / effective_weight_sum as index_value,
    effective_weight_sum,
    n_transactions_used,
    n_strata_used
from agg

-- Regression guard: no (region_scope, stratum, month) cell with n below

-- that could feed a published index point. int_strata__period_medians is
-- supposed to null out median_price below the threshold already - this
-- test fails loudly if that logic ever regresses.

    stratum_key,
    sale_month,
    n,
    median_price

with own_index as (

    select
        region_scope,
        sale_month,
        index_value as own_index_value
    from "ppr"."main_marts"."mart_price_index_monthly"
    where index_variant = 'mixadj_fixed_fullsample'

),

cso_filtered as (

    -- HPM09C01 = index level; '-' = National all-residential, '05' = Dublin all-residential
    select
        case region_code
            when '-' then 'NATIONAL'
            when '05' then 'DUBLIN'
        end as region_scope,
        month as sale_month,
        value as cso_index_value
    from "ppr"."main_staging"."stg_cso__rppi"
    where statistic_code = 'HPM09C01'
      and region_code in ('-', '05')

),

common_base as (

    -- earliest month both series have a value for each region_scope
    select
        o.region_scope,
        min(o.sale_month) as common_base_month
    from own_index o
    join cso_filtered c
        on o.region_scope = c.region_scope
        and o.sale_month = c.sale_month
    where o.own_index_value is not null
      and c.cso_index_value is not null
    group by 1

),

own_base as (

    select
        o.region_scope,
        o.own_index_value as own_base_value
    from own_index o
    join common_base b
        on o.region_scope = b.region_scope
        and o.sale_month = b.common_base_month

),

cso_base as (

    select
        c.region_scope,
        c.cso_index_value as cso_base_value
    from cso_filtered c
    join common_base b
        on c.region_scope = b.region_scope
        and c.sale_month = b.common_base_month

),

rebased as (

    select
        o.region_scope,
        o.sale_month,
        100.0 * o.own_index_value / ob.own_base_value as own_index_rebased,
        100.0 * c.cso_index_value / cb.cso_base_value as cso_index_rebased
    from own_index o
    join own_base ob on o.region_scope = ob.region_scope
    left join cso_filtered c
        on o.region_scope = c.region_scope
        and o.sale_month = c.sale_month
    left join cso_base cb on c.region_scope = cb.region_scope

)

select
    md5(cast(coalesce(cast(region_scope as TEXT), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') || '-' || coalesce(cast(sale_month as TEXT), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') as TEXT)) as index_vs_cso_id,
    region_scope,
    sale_month,
    round(own_index_rebased, 4) as own_index_rebased,
    round(cso_index_rebased, 4) as cso_index_rebased,
    round(own_index_rebased - cso_index_rebased, 4) as level_gap
from rebased

-- Fails if any (region_scope, index_variant) series has a gap month
-- between its own first and last published point. Does not assert a fixed
-- 2010-01 start (that's a business fact confirmed separately in
-- DECISIONS.md / the README), just that once a series starts, it has no
-- holes through to its most recent point.
with series as (
    select region_scope, index_variant, sale_month
    from "ppr"."main_marts"."mart_price_index_monthly"
),

bounds as (
    select
        region_scope,
        index_variant,
        min(sale_month) as min_month,
        max(sale_month) as max_month
    from series
    group by 1, 2
),

expected as (
    select
        b.region_scope,
        b.index_variant,
        unnest(generate_series(b.min_month, b.max_month, interval '1 month'))::date as expected_month
    from bounds b
)

select
    e.region_scope,
    e.index_variant,
    e.expected_month
from expected e
left join series s
    on e.region_scope = s.region_scope
    and e.index_variant = s.index_variant
    and e.expected_month = s.sale_month
where s.sale_month is null
